Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activities in assay CHEMBL4649966. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno, and join assays on assay_id. Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL4649966, standard_value is not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort results by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
